summary.text: Michael Kreun is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 32 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Chris Ford.
He is an attorney who was first elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Kreun earned a bachelor's degree from Moorhead State University in 1998 and a law degree from the University of North Dakota in 2001.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Blaine for 24 years, served on the Spring Lake Park School Board and the Coon Creek Watershed Board of Managers, and works in real estate litigation and corporate litigation management.
He also said he volunteers with the Children's Law Center, representing children in foster care.
Kreun assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Mark Koran (R).
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Capital Investment, Education Finance, and Judiciary and Public Safety Finance and Policy committees.

He said in the survey that his campaign priorities are combating fraud, affordability for families, and supporting law enforcement, and that he was the lead Republican author of the bill creating an Office of Inspector General.
